name: Grok 4.5
short: xAI's 500K-context (450K out) flagship co-developed with Cursor for token-efficient agentic coding; SWE-bench 86.6%, GPQA 93.1%.
modalities: Text, image, file in; text out
standout: Token-efficiency is the speciality: co-developed with Cursor for agentic coding that spends fewer tokens on the same work, backed by an unusually deep output window.
tradeoff: Adoption flows through Cursor/Build surfaces rather than a broad first-party API, which narrows who can use it comfortably.
